shared_elements: dense field of small pictographic/logographic signs (writing-like glyphs)
glyphs incorporating human or animal head forms
a larger figural/animal motif set apart from the sign field
justification: Both surfaces are dominated by dense arrays of small schematic pictographic signs, some incorporating human/animal heads and oval enclosures, set in ordered rows, with a larger figural or focal motif distinguished from the sign field. But the sign forms and their organisation differ sharply: A shows sloping horizontal registers of outline pictorial signs with a modelled animal/figure above, while B is a rigid rectangular border of squared, heavily infilled glyph blocks enclosing a single large hatched disc — a scheme with no counterpart in A.
